messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 28):
"""
5. that the Prospectus submitted is in compliance with the applicable provisions of IRDAI Act 1999, Insurance Act, 1938, Rules, Regulations, Guidelines/Circulars issued thereunder. Date: (Chief Compliance Officer) Name of Insurer: Certification by Appointed Actuary: " I, (name of the appointed actuary), the appointed actuary, hereby solemnly declare that the information furnished in this Application Form is true. I also certify that, in my opinion, the premium rates, advantages, terms and conditions of the above product are workable and sound, the assumptions are reasonable and premium rates are fair." I have carefully studied the requirements of the Product Filing Procedure in relation to the design and rating of insurance products.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Who is required to certify that the premium rates, advantages, terms and conditions of a health insurance product are workable and sound?","answer":"The appointed actuary of the insurer must certify that the premium rates, advantages, terms and conditions are workable and sound.","facts":["\"Certification by Appointed Actuary:\"","\"I, (name of the appointed actuary), the appointed actuary, hereby solemnly declare\"","\"the premium rates, advantages, terms and conditions of the above product are workable and sound\""]},{"question":"What must the appointed actuary confirm in their certification regarding the information in the application form?","answer":"The appointed actuary must confirm that the information furnished in the application form is true and that the premium rates are fair.","facts":["\"the information furnished in this Application Form is true\"","\"the premium rates are fair\""]}]}
